labels.notes: Row partial, unmarked: the module docstring writes `bbsdef:hs_surface_interaction_singular_line` without the ** mark, inside the first 4000 characters, at colI_v1.tex:1508 (checked). ledger.py's mark regex needs `**` right after the closing backtick, so the declaration docstring at l.581 (**`label`: a positive ...**) is not a mark. Faithfulness was read against l.1508-1512, l.906-915, l.917-922, l.782-783 and l.983-984. Under the disclosed readings it holds. (i) GammaLinkCircle.IsPositive has three clauses guarded by the sign of minkQ p, which split the cases exactly. Time-like: a non-regular point has coneAngle < 2π. Space-like, degree k >= 2: l.915's g x >= x on I+, read for every oriented θ, lifted pair and decomposition. Light-like, degree k >= 2: g x >= x on all of the universal cover. Degree 0 (BTZ, Misner, cuspidal) is left free, as the paper does. The decomposition is unique (delta_zpow_mul_unique) and the inequality does not depend on the choices (IsSpacelikePositive.forall, relate), so 'every' is the same as 'some'. (ii) coneAngle = angle f / 2. It is a well-defined invariant (coneAngle_eq), it is 2π at ℓ(p) (coneAngle_regular) and it scales with the translation number, so it is the geometric cone angle whichever of OQ-113 (a)/(b) is taken. coneAngle < 2π iff f < δ² (proved). (iii) The ¬IsRegular guard drops only time-like links of cone angle exactly 2π. At a time-like p, τ(f) = 2 forces f = δ², so the clause amounts to 'cone angle <= 2π'. Regular links do satisfy the other two clauses. (iv) The bridges are genuine iffs with the scaffold notions of HSSingularities: isPositive_iff_of_deSitter (IsSpacelikePositive, g hyperbolic), isPositive_iff_of_null (IsLightlikePositive, g parabolic), isPositive_iff_of_timelike, and IsIso.isPositive_iff. Their hypotheses are met by the circles of exists_positive_negative. (v) Non-vacuity of the circle notion is proved in both directions at every p in dS² (exists_isPositive_and_not_isPositive). The positive witness is non-regular. (vi) SingularHSStructure.IsPositive is the some-link reading: every x in 𝒮 has a positive link at p̄. Each witness is a genuine local HS-isomorphism (strict SingularHSStructure.IsIso: the singular sets match, and near every regular point the map is an SO₀(1,2) element in charts) onto a neighbourhood of the north apex, height 0. The regular circle cannot stand in for a singular point, because IsIso preserves holonomy around x. A positive link at a negative tachyon apex would need the germ to fail to determine the circle up to SO₀(1,2), which is SCOPE (e)/OQ-120 (a). So the some-link reading has no degenerate witness mathematically, but its failure is not exhibited formally (finding 1). (vii) Interactions are read through Σ_x and singular lines through their type L, at p̄ only (SCOPE (d)-(f)). Readings that are disclosed and labelled partial are acceptable. (viii) Inhabitant: 𝔢(L) ∖ {−p̄} (restrictTo, offSouth) is a singular HS-surface with 𝒮 = {p̄}, and it is positive with a non-regular positive tachyon link (exists_isPositive_isSingularHSSurface). Both REPORT findings are true. Finding (1): l.948-953 do not require the points of 𝒮 to be singular, strict HSSuspension's SCOPE (e) already says so, and a regular time-like point of 𝒮 has cone angle exactly 2π, which fails a literal '< 2π'. Finding (2): exists_isPositive_delta_four builds a non-regular space-like circle at p with lifted holonomy δ⁴ (every decomposition has k = 4 and g = 1). It is positive in l.915's form with equality, it is neither IsSpacelikePositive nor IsSpacelikeNegative, and its holonomy is central, so its underlying ℝP¹-circle is not hyperbolic (paper l.693-702: it is 'elliptic'), against l.794-795. Def Hcausal (l.1114) excludes degree >= 4, and every singular circle with trivial holonomy has degree >= 4, so the remark about causal surfaces is correct. Graduation: the file imports scaffold GXScaffold.BBS.HSSingularities, which itself imports scaffold GXScaffold.BBS.PSL2NormalForms and GXScaffold.Interaction.FunnelGTilde. HSPositive can graduate only after that chain.

findings.what: No formal witness shows that `GX.SingularHSStructure.IsPositive`, the some-link reading T-3p1-theorem-g will consume, can fail. The only negative non-vacuity result, `GX.exists_not_isPositiveEvery`, is about the every-link reading `IsPositiveEvery`. To show that 𝔢(L) or 𝔢(L) ∖ {−p̄} is not positive for a negative tachyon L, one needs every apex link of p̄ to be isomorphic to L up to SO₀(1,2). That is the 'type is well defined' question left open in SCOPE (e) and OQ-120 (a). The definition is not degenerate mathematically (IsIso is a genuine local HS-isomorphism), but the formal record shows only one side.
findings.fix: Do not edit HSPositive (scope). State in SCOPE (e) that the some-link reading is shown satisfiable but not shown falsifiable. Or add a follow-up target: germ rigidity at the apex, i.e. IsApexLink x C and IsApexLink x C' imply C ≅ B·C' for some B in SO₀(1,2). With OQ-120 (a) it gives ¬ IsPositive for 𝔢(L') ∖ {−p̄}, and IsPositive ↔ IsPositiveEvery under HasApexLinks.

findings.what: Finding 2 says that in l.908-913's form the δ⁴ circle 'is neither positive nor negative: it is neither IsSpacelikePositive nor …IsSpacelikeNegative'. Those two definitions are themselves l.915's form plus the guard that g is hyperbolic. The Lean conjuncts show that the guard fails (g = 1). They do not formalize the repelling/attracting form of l.908-913, which SCOPE (g) lists as not formalized. The mathematical claim is true: for g = 1 no fixed point is repelling or attracting, and l.894 presupposes g hyperbolic. As worded, though, an author could take the repelling/attracting form to be formalized.
findings.fix: Reword the finding when it goes to the author, roughly: 'the dichotomy of l.908-913 presupposes g hyperbolic (l.894); for g = 1 no fixed point is repelling or attracting (argued); formally the circle is neither IsSpacelikePositive nor IsSpacelikeNegative because both require g hyperbolic'.

findings.what: The docstring of `GX.exists_isPositive_isSingularHSSurface` says the singular point is linked by a positive non-regular space-like circle 'of degree 2'. The statement does not include the degree. The degree is 2 only by the construction inside exists_positive_negative, whose statement gives k >= 1 through IsSpacelikePositive. This is a nit: the claim is true but not stated.
findings.fix: Drop 'of degree 2' from the docstring, or add the degree (a lifted pair with f = δ² g) to the conclusion when the file is next edited.
